column1: # Short words in clear within the cipher of letters A to D (see the top of data/groups.tsv), of the
# kind that Kolosova describes as not to be read (thesis, p. 229). Each letter was searched for them on
# the images, and one may have been missed. Longer phrases in clear, which A and C have often, are not listed.
# letter, image, line: the place, with lines counted as docs/METHOD.md says. The crops in
#   images/parallels/ are named by letter, image and lines.
# clear: the words in clear as written.
# text: the deciphered text where the cipher resumes, with a word or two before it where the words in
#   clear stand inside a sentence. For A and C it is the decipherment of 1521, and for B and D Danvila's
# status: read if the deciphered text has the words in clear, omitted if it has nothing for them.
